query:
SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', NULLIF(mui.first_name, 'N/A'),
                                               NULLIF(mui.last_name, 'N/A'))), '') AS "name?: String"
               FROM macro_user_info mui
               JOIN "User" u ON u.macro_user_id = mui.macro_user_id
               WHERE u.id = $1
